metadata.name: generating-python-installer
metadata.description: Commercial-grade Python installer expert for Windows: Nuitka extreme compilation, dist slimming, DLL footprint analysis, and Inno Setup packaging to ship the smallest, fastest installers. Use when a Python app must ship as a minimal, fast-starting Windows installer; not for basic script-to-exe conversion. Trigger concepts: advanced Nuitka optimization, commercial Python packaging, aggressive compilation, dist slimming, DLL analysis, minimal installers, and fast startup.
